gloss: Not limited to one style; open to diverse approaches.
teaser: Today, we explore the beauty of flexibility in thinking.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Today, we explore the beauty of flexibility in thinking. [break 1s] The phrase is: 不拘一格, bù jū yī gé. [break 0.5s] 不 (bù) - not; [break 0.5s] 拘 (jū) - to restrict; [break 0.5s] 一 (yī) - one; [break 0.5s] 格 (gé) - style or standard. [break 1s] So, 不拘一格 literally means 'not restricted to one style,' and figuratively, it implies being open to diverse methods or ideas. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the world of art and literature, where it was often said that true creativity cannot be confined to a single format or style. Great thinkers and artists throughout history have embraced diversity in their work, encouraging others to do the same. Thus, this phrase encourages innovation and the acceptance of various perspectives. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 他在设计上不拘一格，创造了许多独特的作品。 [break 1s] He is not limited to one style in his designs, creating many unique works. [break 1s] Example 2: 教师应该不拘一格，以适应不同学生的需求。 [break 1s] Teachers should be flexible in their methods to meet the needs of different students. [break 1s] Example 3: 这家公司鼓励员工不拘一格地思考，推动创新。 [break 1s] This company encourages employees to think outside the box, fostering innovation. [break 1s] So, 不拘一格 means being open to diverse approaches. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
